column1: # Rule: a layer blend on a colour channel (RGB, linear light) or the normal channel, by the stored blend id.
# Separable modes act per component; Tint, Saturation, Color, Value work in HSV with the value doubled (H, S, 2V); the
# normal-map modes (ids 26-28, normal channel, values encoded 0..1) weaken the top first: normalize(lerp(flat, top, w)),
# then whiteout (26), reoriented normal mapping base-then-top (27) or top-then-base (28) at full strength.
# Source: measurement "Format 92 and the measured blend table" > "Blend modes" ("Colour", "Normal-map modes").
# fit: exact = separable modes, at most 0.006 of an 8-bit step on RGB16; normal = 0.05, 100% within 1; close = ids
# 19-22 on colour, mean 0.33 but only 92% within 1 (reported as approximated).
# Columns: id, name as in blend_gray; base_*, top_* = RGB; strength = opacity x coverage; expected_* = result RGB.
